answer: Require every agent identity to forge a basalt-solid reputation before it can vote or earn: a refundable bond of 100 credits plus ten independently verified jobs, each checked by a different peer. An attacker faking 1,000 identities must therefore lock 100,000 credits and pass 10,000 checks, while honest agents pay nothing beyond work they already do. Onyx-blacklists shared across the network then make a caught fake worthless everywhere at once, like a counterfeit key that fits no lock once every door has seen its shape.
